meta.label: IAM Roles Anywhere
meta.description: Define a preset that DSS users can use to authenticate into IAM Roles Anywhere Endpoint.

params.name: certificate_path
params.label: Certificate Path
params.description: The full path name of the TLS certificate to authenticate with IAM Roles Anywhere

params.name: private_key_path
params.label: Private Key Path
params.description: The full path name of the TLS private key to authenticate with IAM Roles Anywhere

params.name: trust_anchor_arn
params.label: Trust Anchor ARN
params.description: The ARN of the Trust Anchor to use configured at IAM Roles Anywhere

params.name: profile_arn
params.label: Profile ARN
params.description: The ARN of the Profile to pull policies, attribute mappings and other data configured at IAM Roles Anywhere

params.name: base_role_arn
params.label: Base Role ARN
params.description: The Base Role ARN to authenticate via x509 certificate and aws_signing_helper

params.name: target_role_enable
params.label: Assume Target Role
params.description: Enable to assume a Target Role

params.name: target_role_arn
params.label: Target Role ARN
params.description: The Target Role ARN to assume to access AWS resources

params.name: region
params.label: Region
params.description: The AWS Region configured for IAM Roles Anywhere
